items.title: Cityview and Accor plan Mövenpick-branded homes in Motor City
items.summary: Cityview Developments signed with Accor to deliver 408 Mövenpick-branded residences in Dubai Motor City, slated for completion in 2028.

items.title: Pullman-branded residences and offices planned for Meydan
items.summary: Second Cityview–Accor project combines 282 Pullman-branded residences with branded offices in Meydan; opening targeted for 2029.

items.title: DHG Properties begins handover of Helvetia Residences in JVC
items.summary: The Swiss-backed developer completed its first Dubai project and started handing over the fully sold 430 studio to three-bedroom apartments.

items.title: Alef says Linar waterfront homes fully sold; new project due 20 October
items.summary: At SIF 2026 Alef reported a complete residential sell-out of its AED 4bn Linar waterfront development and previewed a new project set to launch publicly on 20 October.
